task_description: Issue #31: Add a lightweight, dismissible first-run onboarding hint for the AI Monster game. On first load the player only sees the egg (baby) and panels with no guidance. Show a one-time understated hint ('まずは『トレーニング』で成長期を目指そう！' / English equivalent) that is dismissible and persists a ddm.onboarded flag in localStorage so it never shows again. Optionally summarize what is still needed to evolve (remaining training count / minutes) via the shared evolutionProgress. Keep the existing understated tone (no heavy modal). JA/EN parity for all new strings. Frontend-only; ships via frontend redeploy. Agent commits locally on feat/onboarding-hint; orchestrator pushes and opens the PR.

non_blocking_notes: Hint shows until dismissed even for a returning already-evolved monster (matches issue intent: first-run + persisted dismiss flag).
onboarding.ctaFinal branch is effectively dead for a true first-run player (harmless, still correct and tested).
No automated coverage of the localStorage guards or the OnboardingHint/App DOM wiring; the pure helpers are well covered.

verification.summary: Shared tests 47 pass. Frontend helper tests 59 pass (55 baseline + 4 new). Frontend build (tsc + vite) succeeds, proving JA/EN i18n key parity via the typed EN dict. No Dockerfile for the frontend package; docker build skipped. Test quality verified: new tests drive real evolutionProgress output through onboardingCta with exact JA/EN assertions and >=0 clamping, and cover the shouldShowOnboarding truth table; they exercise the new code paths and would fail if reverted.
